subject.title: Skill Workshop: scan older sessions for skill ideas

question: Should Skill Workshop adopt the proposed operator-triggered, per-agent progressive history scan, and what stable session ordering and reset semantics should define its persisted cursor?
rationale: Current main has the necessary proposal safety lifecycle, but privacy, provider cost, transcript eligibility, cursor semantics, and UI behavior are product choices that source inspection cannot safely choose automatically.

options.title: Bounded progressive scan
options.body: Add the manual newest-to-oldest flow with explicit batch limits, pending-only proposals, SQLite cursor state, visible coverage, and an operator reset action.

options.title: Explicit source selection only
options.body: Extend `/learn` and the Workshop UI to select named prior sessions without maintaining an automatic historical cursor, reducing background state and privacy complexity.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Retain current-turn autonomous review and ad hoc `/learn`, leaving historical mining outside the supported Workshop workflow.

recommendation.title: Bounded progressive scan
recommendation.body: Add the manual newest-to-oldest flow with explicit batch limits, pending-only proposals, SQLite cursor state, visible coverage, and an operator reset action.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced Skill Workshop, authored this detailed product proposal, and are assigned to the issue.
